title: 農電共生系統設計
summary: 農電共生把模組架在農地上方，讓作物與發電共用陽光。德國黑格爾巴赫的試驗場把 194 kWp 的模組架在五公尺高，底下照常以大型農機耕作；兩年的試驗顯示，在乾熱的年份遮蔭甚至讓部分作物增產。課程定量分析土地等效比、到達作物的光量、模組邊緣的雨水集中、遮蔭減少的蒸散量，以及發電收入與農業收入的懸殊比例。
summaryEn: Agrivoltaics mounts modules above farmland so crops and generation share the sun. The Heggelbach pilot in Germany set 194 kWp of modules five metres up with large farm machines working beneath as usual; two years of trials showed shade even raised some yields in a hot dry year. The course quantifies land equivalent ratio, light reaching crops, concentration of rain at module edges, evapotranspiration saved by shade, and the wide gap between generating and farming income.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 同一塊地既種田又發電：土地等效比、作物的光量、雨水集中、蒸散與收益的平衡
v30FocusEn: Farming and generating on the same land: land equivalent ratio, light for crops, concentrated rain, evapotranspiration and the balance of income

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：農電共生系統設計
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Agrivoltaic System Design
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「用地與功率密度」與「土地等效比」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Land use and power density" and "Land equivalent ratio": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「用地與功率密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Land use and power density" is correct?
options: 大型光電園區的功率密度一般在每平方公里 30 至 70 MWp 之間，取決於模組效率、排距與是否採追日。
光電園區的面積全部都鋪滿了模組。
在農地上裝模組，作物的產量一定大幅減少。
optionsEn: Power density of large PV parks is typically 30–70 MWp per square kilometre, depending on module efficiency, row spacing and tracking.
The whole area of a PV park is covered with modules.
Putting modules over farmland must cut crop yield sharply.
quiz.explanation: 大型光電園區的功率密度一般在每平方公里 30 至 70 MWp 之間，取決於模組效率、排距與是否採追日。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Power density of large PV parks is typically 30–70 MWp per square kilometre, depending on module efficiency, row spacing and tracking. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 用地與功率密度：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Land use and power density: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「用地與功率密度」如何決定「農電共生系統設計」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Land use and power density” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Agrivoltaic System Design”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 大型光電園區的功率密度一般在每平方公里 30 至 70 MWp 之間，取決於模組效率、排距與是否採追日。排距要兼顧冬季不互相遮蔭與土地成本；追日系統為了避免晨昏互遮，排距更大、密度更低，但單位容量發電量較高。園區面積還包含道路、變電站、圍籬與排水設施，所以「園區總面積」與「模組覆蓋面積」是兩回事。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power density of large PV parks is typically 30–70 MWp per square kilometre, depending on module efficiency, row spacing and tracking. Spacing balances winter self-shading against land cost; trackers need wider spacing to avoid mutual shading at low sun and so have lower density but higher yield per unit capacity. Park area also covers roads, substations, fencing and drainage, so total park area and module-covered area are different things. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：試驗場的容量為 194 kWp，2016 年建成
steps.observationEn: Project file: The pilot is 194 kWp, built in 2016
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光電園區的面積全部都鋪滿了模組。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The whole area of a PV park is covered with modules." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「用地與功率密度」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Land use and power density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 用地與功率密度
knowledge.text: 大型光電園區的功率密度一般在每平方公里 30 至 70 MWp 之間，取決於模組效率、排距與是否採追日。排距要兼顧冬季不互相遮蔭與土地成本；追日系統為了避免晨昏互遮，排距更大、密度更低，但單位容量發電量較高。園區面積還包含道路、變電站、圍籬與排水設施，所以「園區總面積」與「模組覆蓋面積」是兩回事。
knowledge.textEn: Power density of large PV parks is typically 30–70 MWp per square kilometre, depending on module efficiency, row spacing and tracking. Spacing balances winter self-shading against land cost; trackers need wider spacing to avoid mutual shading at low sun and so have lower density but higher yield per unit capacity. Park area also covers roads, substations, fencing and drainage, so total park area and module-covered area are different things.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光電園區的面積全部都鋪滿了模組。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The whole area of a PV park is covered with modules. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 試驗場的容量為 194 kWp，2016 年建成
knowledge.textEn: The pilot is 194 kWp, built in 2016

quiz.question: 依「用地與功率密度」的模型 ρ_P = P_dc / A，園區的直流功率密度最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model ρ_P = P_dc / A for "Land use and power density", which value is closest to the DC power density of the park?
options: 28.5 MWp/km²
57.1 MWp/km²
571 MWp/km²
optionsEn: 28.5 MWp/km²
57.1 MWp/km²
571 MWp/km²
quiz.explanation: ρ_P = P_dc / A；代入 Pdc = 0.194 MWp、area = 0.0034 km²，得 57.1 MWp/km²（園區的直流功率密度）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: ρ_P = P_dc / A; with Pdc = 0.194 MWp, area = 0.0034 km² the result is 57.1 MWp/km² (DC power density of the park). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 用地與功率密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Land use and power density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「用地與功率密度」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Land use and power density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ρ_P = P_dc / A；代入 Pdc = 0.194 MWp、area = 0.0034 km²，得 57.1 MWp/km²（園區的直流功率密度）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 area 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ρ_P = P_dc / A; with Pdc = 0.194 MWp, area = 0.0034 km² the result is 57.1 MWp/km² (DC power density of the park). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise area by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：area 增加 10% 時，結果變為 51.9 MWp/km²（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising area by 10% changes the result to 51.9 MWp/km² (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 57.1 MWp/km²（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 area 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 57.1 MWp/km² (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in area with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ρ_P = P_dc / A；代入 Pdc = 0.194 MWp、area = 0.0034 km²，得 57.1 MWp/km²（園區的直流功率密度）。
knowledge.textEn: ρ_P = P_dc / A; with Pdc = 0.194 MWp, area = 0.0034 km² the result is 57.1 MWp/km² (DC power density of the park).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: area 增加 10% 時，結果變為 51.9 MWp/km²（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising area by 10% changes the result to 51.9 MWp/km² (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「用地與功率密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Land use and power density"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
天氣越熱、太陽越大，太陽能板發的電就越多。
以衛星影像或竣工圖量測實際模組覆蓋面積與地面覆蓋率（GCR），並以實測遮蔭損失核對排距設計。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The hotter and sunnier the day, the more electricity a solar panel produces.
Measure actual module-covered area and ground coverage ratio from satellite imagery or as-built drawings, and check row-spacing design against measured shading loss.
quiz.explanation: 以衛星影像或竣工圖量測實際模組覆蓋面積與地面覆蓋率（GCR），並以實測遮蔭損失核對排距設計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure actual module-covered area and ground coverage ratio from satellite imagery or as-built drawings, and check row-spacing design against measured shading loss. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 用地與功率密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Land use and power density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「用地與功率密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Land use and power density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以衛星影像或竣工圖量測實際模組覆蓋面積與地面覆蓋率（GCR），並以實測遮蔭損失核對排距設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual module-covered area and ground coverage ratio from satellite imagery or as-built drawings, and check row-spacing design against measured shading loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：佈置方案要以全年逐時模擬比較不同排距的發電量與土地成本，並保留清洗與維修車輛的通道寬度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare layouts by hourly simulation of yield and land cost for different spacings, keeping aisle width for cleaning and maintenance vehicles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了在有限土地上多裝容量而縮小排距，冬季與晨昏的列間遮蔭使下排電池串被旁路，發電量損失遠大於被遮面積的比例。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tightening row spacing to fit more capacity on limited land causes inter-row shading in winter and at low sun that bypasses lower cell strings, losing far more energy than the shaded area suggests. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以衛星影像或竣工圖量測實際模組覆蓋面積與地面覆蓋率（GCR），並以實測遮蔭損失核對排距設計。
knowledge.textEn: Measure actual module-covered area and ground coverage ratio from satellite imagery or as-built drawings, and check row-spacing design against measured shading loss.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 佈置方案要以全年逐時模擬比較不同排距的發電量與土地成本，並保留清洗與維修車輛的通道寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Compare layouts by hourly simulation of yield and land cost for different spacings, keeping aisle width for cleaning and maintenance vehicles.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61215 地面用太陽光電模組設計驗證與型式認可。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61215 Terrestrial photovoltaic modules – Design qualification and type approval. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「用地與功率密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Land use and power density" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了在有限土地上多裝容量而縮小排距，冬季與晨昏的列間遮蔭使下排電池串被旁路，發電量損失遠大於被遮面積的比例。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
在農地上裝模組，作物的產量一定大幅減少。
optionsEn: Tightening row spacing to fit more capacity on limited land causes inter-row shading in winter and at low sun that bypasses lower cell strings, losing far more energy than the shaded area suggests.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Putting modules over farmland must cut crop yield sharply.
quiz.explanation: 為了在有限土地上多裝容量而縮小排距，冬季與晨昏的列間遮蔭使下排電池串被旁路，發電量損失遠大於被遮面積的比例。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tightening row spacing to fit more capacity on limited land causes inter-row shading in winter and at low sun that bypasses lower cell strings, losing far more energy than the shaded area suggests. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 用地與功率密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Land use and power density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「用地與功率密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Land use and power density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了在有限土地上多裝容量而縮小排距，冬季與晨昏的列間遮蔭使下排電池串被旁路，發電量損失遠大於被遮面積的比例。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「農電共生系統設計」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Tightening row spacing to fit more capacity on limited land causes inter-row shading in winter and at low sun that bypasses lower cell strings, losing far more energy than the shaded area suggests. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Agrivoltaic System Design”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：園區面積還包含道路、變電站、圍籬與排水設施，所以「園區總面積」與「模組覆蓋面積」是兩回事。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Park area also covers roads, substations, fencing and drainage, so total park area and module-covered area are different things.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光電園區的面積全部都鋪滿了模組。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The whole area of a PV park is covered with modules." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了在有限土地上多裝容量而縮小排距，冬季與晨昏的列間遮蔭使下排電池串被旁路，發電量損失遠大於被遮面積的比例。
knowledge.textEn: Tightening row spacing to fit more capacity on limited land causes inter-row shading in winter and at low sun that bypasses lower cell strings, losing far more energy than the shaded area suggests.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1981：農電共生的概念首次被提出
knowledge.textEn: 1981: The concept of agrivoltaics was first proposed

quiz.question: 關於「土地等效比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Land equivalent ratio" is correct?
options: 在農地上裝模組，作物的產量一定大幅減少。
作物需要所有照到田裡的陽光。
評估農電共生是否「划算」的指標叫土地等效比。
optionsEn: Putting modules over farmland must cut crop yield sharply.
Crops need all the sunlight falling on a field.
The measure of whether agrivoltaics pays is land equivalent ratio.
quiz.explanation: 評估農電共生是否「划算」的指標叫土地等效比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The measure of whether agrivoltaics pays is land equivalent ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 土地等效比：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Land equivalent ratio: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「土地等效比」如何決定「農電共生系統設計」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Land equivalent ratio” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Agrivoltaic System Design”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 評估農電共生是否「划算」的指標叫土地等效比。假設一公頃共生的土地，作物產量是純農地的八成，發電量是純光電場的八成；那麼要用分開的土地得到同樣的產出，就需要零點八公頃的農地加上零點八公頃的光電場，合計一點六公頃。等效比大於一，表示共生比分開使用更節省土地。它的大小取決於作物對遮蔭的耐受度：耐陰的葉菜與漿果損失很小，需要強光的玉米與小麥損失大；乾旱年份遮蔭反而有保護作用。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The measure of whether agrivoltaics pays is land equivalent ratio. Suppose a shared hectare yields eight tenths the crop of plain farmland and eight tenths the energy of a plain solar field; getting the same from separate land needs 0.8 hectare of farm plus 0.8 of solar, 1.6 in all. A ratio above one means sharing saves land over separate use. Its size depends on shade tolerance of the crop: leafy vegetables and berries lose little, maize and wheat that need strong light lose much, and in drought years shade actually protects. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：模組下緣離地約 5 m，可讓大型農機通過
steps.observationEn: Project file: The lower edge of modules is about 5 m up, clearing large farm machines
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「在農地上裝模組，作物的產量一定大幅減少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Putting modules over farmland must cut crop yield sharply." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「土地等效比」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Land equivalent ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 土地等效比
knowledge.text: 評估農電共生是否「划算」的指標叫土地等效比。假設一公頃共生的土地，作物產量是純農地的八成，發電量是純光電場的八成；那麼要用分開的土地得到同樣的產出，就需要零點八公頃的農地加上零點八公頃的光電場，合計一點六公頃。等效比大於一，表示共生比分開使用更節省土地。它的大小取決於作物對遮蔭的耐受度：耐陰的葉菜與漿果損失很小，需要強光的玉米與小麥損失大；乾旱年份遮蔭反而有保護作用。
knowledge.textEn: The measure of whether agrivoltaics pays is land equivalent ratio. Suppose a shared hectare yields eight tenths the crop of plain farmland and eight tenths the energy of a plain solar field; getting the same from separate land needs 0.8 hectare of farm plus 0.8 of solar, 1.6 in all. A ratio above one means sharing saves land over separate use. Its size depends on shade tolerance of the crop: leafy vegetables and berries lose little, maize and wheat that need strong light lose much, and in drought years shade actually protects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：在農地上裝模組，作物的產量一定大幅減少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Putting modules over farmland must cut crop yield sharply. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「土地等效比」的模型 LER = y_c + y_e，作物產量為對照的 0.80、發電量為對照的 0.80 時的土地等效比（代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model LER = y_c + y_e for "Land equivalent ratio", which value is closest to the land equivalent ratio for crop yield at 0.80 and energy at 0.80 of reference (representative values)?
optionsEn: 1.60 times
16.0 times
0.800 times
quiz.explanation: LER = y_c + y_e；代入 yc = 0.8、ye = 0.8，得 1.60 倍（作物產量為對照的 0.80、發電量為對照的 0.80 時的土地等效比（代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: LER = y_c + y_e; with yc = 0.8, ye = 0.8 the result is 1.60 times (land equivalent ratio for crop yield at 0.80 and energy at 0.80 of reference (representative values)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 土地等效比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Land equivalent ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「土地等效比」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Land equivalent ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：LER = y_c + y_e；代入 yc = 0.8、ye = 0.8，得 1.60 倍（作物產量為對照的 0.80、發電量為對照的 0.80 時的土地等效比（代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 yc 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: LER = y_c + y_e; with yc = 0.8, ye = 0.8 the result is 1.60 times (land equivalent ratio for crop yield at 0.80 and energy at 0.80 of reference (representative values)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise yc by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：yc 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.68 倍（+5.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising yc by 10% changes the result to 1.68 times (+5.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.60 倍（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 yc 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.60 times (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in yc with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: LER = y_c + y_e；代入 yc = 0.8、ye = 0.8，得 1.60 倍（作物產量為對照的 0.80、發電量為對照的 0.80 時的土地等效比（代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: LER = y_c + y_e; with yc = 0.8, ye = 0.8 the result is 1.60 times (land equivalent ratio for crop yield at 0.80 and energy at 0.80 of reference (representative values)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: yc 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.68 倍（+5.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising yc by 10% changes the result to 1.68 times (+5.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「土地等效比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Land equivalent ratio"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在共生區旁設置沒有模組的對照田，以相同的品種與栽培管理比較多個年度的產量與品質。
遮蔭對作物只有壞處。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
A control plot without modules beside the shared area, with the same varieties and husbandry, compares yield and quality over several years.
Shade does crops nothing but harm.
quiz.explanation: 在共生區旁設置沒有模組的對照田，以相同的品種與栽培管理比較多個年度的產量與品質。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: A control plot without modules beside the shared area, with the same varieties and husbandry, compares yield and quality over several years. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 土地等效比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Land equivalent ratio: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「土地等效比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Land equivalent ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在共生區旁設置沒有模組的對照田，以相同的品種與栽培管理比較多個年度的產量與品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: A control plot without modules beside the shared area, with the same varieties and husbandry, compares yield and quality over several years. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：共生系統的設計要依作物的光需求決定遮光程度，並以多年度的對照試驗驗證產量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set the degree of shading from the crop's light requirement, and verify yields by multi-year controlled trials.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以一年的試驗結果下結論時，可能剛好遇到特別乾或特別濕的年份，高估或低估了長期的表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Conclusions from one year's trial may catch an unusually dry or wet year and over- or understate long-term performance. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在共生區旁設置沒有模組的對照田，以相同的品種與栽培管理比較多個年度的產量與品質。
knowledge.textEn: A control plot without modules beside the shared area, with the same varieties and husbandry, compares yield and quality over several years.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 共生系統的設計要依作物的光需求決定遮光程度，並以多年度的對照試驗驗證產量。
knowledge.textEn: Set the degree of shading from the crop's light requirement, and verify yields by multi-year controlled trials.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 61730 太陽光電模組安全驗證。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 61730 Photovoltaic module safety qualification. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「土地等效比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Land equivalent ratio" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
作物需要所有照到田裡的陽光。
只以一年的試驗結果下結論時，可能剛好遇到特別乾或特別濕的年份，高估或低估了長期的表現。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Crops need all the sunlight falling on a field.
Conclusions from one year's trial may catch an unusually dry or wet year and over- or understate long-term performance.
quiz.explanation: 只以一年的試驗結果下結論時，可能剛好遇到特別乾或特別濕的年份，高估或低估了長期的表現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Conclusions from one year's trial may catch an unusually dry or wet year and over- or understate long-term performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 土地等效比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Land equivalent ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「土地等效比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Land equivalent ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以一年的試驗結果下結論時，可能剛好遇到特別乾或特別濕的年份，高估或低估了長期的表現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「農電共生系統設計」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Conclusions from one year's trial may catch an unusually dry or wet year and over- or understate long-term performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Agrivoltaic System Design”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：它的大小取決於作物對遮蔭的耐受度：耐陰的葉菜與漿果損失很小，需要強光的玉米與小麥損失大；乾旱年份遮蔭反而有保護作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its size depends on shade tolerance of the crop: leafy vegetables and berries lose little, maize and wheat that need strong light lose much, and in drought years shade actually protects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「在農地上裝模組，作物的產量一定大幅減少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Putting modules over farmland must cut crop yield sharply." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以一年的試驗結果下結論時，可能剛好遇到特別乾或特別濕的年份，高估或低估了長期的表現。
knowledge.textEn: Conclusions from one year's trial may catch an unusually dry or wet year and over- or understate long-term performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
